Information for Tenderer/Consultant :
Eligibility of Tenderer : 1. The minimum specific experience as a Prime Contractor in construction works of at least 1(One) contract(s) of the minimum
value of similar nature, complexity and method/construction technology successfully completed within the last 10(ten) years, with a
value of at least Tk.8.50 Crore .Years counting back ward from the date of publication of IFT in e-Gp portal.
The Contractor must have the following specific experience in the above Mentioned and other contract :
(i) Must have experience of RCC road construction.
(ii) Must have experience of Steel shed construction with a value of Minimum Tk.1.50 crore.
2. The required average annual construction turnover shall be greater than Tk. 17 (Seventeen) Crore in the last 5 (Five) years.
Payment certificates for contract in progress or completed under public sector during last 5 (five) years must be submitted along
with the tender in support of average annual construction turnover.
3. Liquid assets/ working capital/credit facilities Tk. 4.50 crore.
4. The Tender Capacity is Tk. 9 (Nine) crore. Supporting document must be submitted along with information as per enclosed form
(ongoing works/commitments)
5. The Tenderer must enclose up-to-date Trade license, Income Tax clearance certificate, VAT registration certificate.
6. Personnel Capacity & Equipment Capacity as per TDS.
Brief Description of Works : Counter building with steel shed construction, Internal RCC road,Yeard development (HBB works),RCC drain, Footpath, RCC
ramp, Walkway,RCC boundary wall etc.
